body.honesty: Continuous intelligence, not continuous trading. OpportunityDiscovery never emits TRADE_IDEA_GENERATED. Planner cap is MarketDataWorker.getEffectiveStreamingCap(): Alpaca/default uses maxActiveSubscriptions=12; ibkr_gateway raises hardCapOverride to ibkrConnection.maxMarketDataLines (90). When emptySlots>0, Discovery fills up to maxNewSubscriptionsPerCycle (20) per scan. OpportunityScreener ideas need ARGUS_OPPORTUNITY_IDEAS_ENABLED (one vote — consensus 0.75/min-2 unchanged). Missed-opportunity detection (Phase 4F) is diagnostic-only: it classifies where a PROMOTE-recommended candidate stalled in the funnel using existing telemetry, and never emits a trade idea or affects sizing/consensus.
body.consensusNote: ChiefTrader min-agents and 0.75 bar are unchanged. Risk-exit SELL from PortfolioManager still skips entry quorum and still hits RiskEngine/OMS.
